tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with tasks table (id, title, description, status, created_at, completed_at)
Build Node.js/Express REST API with endpoints for CRUD operations on tasks (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
Create React component structure with routing for Task List, Create Task, Task Detail, Completed Tasks, and Profile screens
Implement Task List screen with task cards, floating action button, and bottom navigation using design specifications
Build Create Task form with title/description inputs, validation, and error handling
Implement task completion toggle functionality with status updates and UI state changes
Create Delete Confirmation Modal component with overlay and confirmation flow
Build Completed Tasks screen with filtered view and reactivation capability
Implement Task Detail screen with full description view and action buttons
Apply color scheme, typography, and responsive design styles across all components
Add accessibility features including ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
Integrate animations for button presses, screen transitions, and modal appearances

risks: Database connection failures could block all CRUD operations if PostgreSQL setup is not properly configured
API endpoint errors or missing validation could allow invalid task data to be saved
React state management complexity may cause UI sync issues between task list and detail views
Mobile responsiveness issues if design specifications are not tested across different screen sizes
Performance degradation with large task lists if pagination or virtualization is not implemented
